answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 195 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the wharf ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the walnut review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the ripple gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
